data.title: Rio Tinto gets up to $995M defense logistics deal: Details inside
data.description:
• Rio Tinto Group (RIO)'s unit, Rio Tinto Logistics, won a maximum $995M IDIQ contract on Friday for high-purity aluminum.
  • The five-year contract has no option periods and runs through May 7, 2031.
  • The contract is funded with fiscal 2025–2029 transaction funds and was awarded by the Defense Logistics Agency Contracting Services Office.

data.title: Metallus wins up to $995M defense contract for high-fragmentation steel
data.description:
• Metallus (MUS) was awarded a maximum $995M U.S. defense contract for High Fragmentation 1 Steel.
  • The five-year contract runs through Sept. 24, 2031, with no option periods.
  • The funding comes from fiscal 2025–2029 transaction funds under the contract, with the DLA Contracting Services Office serving as the contracting activity.

data.title: Kongsberg Gruppen boosts U.S. defense push with $404M missile deal
data.description:
• Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace, a unit of Kongsberg Gruppen (NSKFF), won a $404.4M U.S. defense IDIQ contract for Naval Strike Missile launcher units, weapon control systems, and related support equipment.
  • The contract covers full-rate production and sustainment support through Sept. 24, 2034.
  • No funds were committed at award, while payments will be made through individual delivery and task orders as they are issued.
  • Portfolio Acquisition Executive, Marine Corps, is the contracting activity.

data.title: Future Money Acquisition faces Nasdaq notice over delayed 10-Q filing
data.description:
• Future Money Acquisition (FMAC) said on Friday that it received a Nasdaq compliance notice for failing to timely file its quarterly Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026.
  • The company has until Nov. 23, 2026, to submit a plan to regain compliance.
  • If accepted, Nasdaq could give the company until March 22, 2027, to complete the filing and regain compliance.
  • The company said it is working to file the report as soon as possible, but failure to meet the requirements could put its Nasdaq listing at risk.

data.title: Future Money Acquisition faces Nasdaq compliance issue
data.description:
• Future Money Acquisition (FMAC) received a Nasdaq deficiency notice on September 22, 2026, for failing to file its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026.
  • The company has until November 23, 2026, to submit a plan to regain compliance.
  • If Nasdaq accepts the plan, the company may receive up to 180 additional days, until March 22, 2027, to regain compliance.
  • If Nasdaq rejects the plan, FMAC may appeal the decision to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel.

data.title: Netcapital faces Nasdaq filing compliance issue
Facebook loses high-profile case in New Mexico over deceiving users
data.description:
Facebook (META) was found guilty by a New Mexico jury of being liable for deceiving users about privacy protections on the platform. The decision was the second that went against the company in the state this year, although appeal processes could take years to play out.  

The jury found over 43M violations of state consumer protection law, and it is now up to the judge to determine how much the company will pay, with attorneys representing the state asking for the maximum $5K penalty per violation.

"The verdict marks a significant victory for New Mexico consumers and holds one of the world’s largest technology companies accountable for its conduct," read a statement from the New Mexico Department of Justice.

New Mexico's attorney general sued the company in 2021, arguing that Meta (META) was selling that data to third-party apps while misleading users. The case drew widespread attention because it was tied to the controversial political consulting firm Cambridge Analytica.

Shares of Meta Platforms (META) fell 3.3% on Friday to $751.66.

data.title: Quest PharmaTech announces CEO change
data.description:
• Quest PharmaTech (QPT:CA) announced that Madi Madiyalakan will retire as CEO effective November 23, 2026.
  • Jeffrey Shon, a Quest director, will succeed Madiyalakan as CEO.

data.title: Calidi Biotherapeutics gets NYSE compliance warning but stock surprises
data.description:
• Calidi Biotherapeutics (CLDI) announced on Friday that it received a NYSE American compliance notice for failing to meet the exchange’s $4M minimum stockholders’ equity requirement.
  • The notice has no immediate impact on trading. The stock will continue trading on NYSE American, but with a “.BC” below-compliance designation.
  • The company must submit a compliance plan by Oct. 21, 2026, with until March 21, 2028, to regain compliance.
  • If the plan is rejected, not submitted, or the company fails to make sufficient progress, NYSE American could begin delisting proceedings.
  • However, the stock traded nearly 4% higher at ~$1.17 in the after-hours trading session.

data.title: Trimble evaluates breaking up transportation unit in sale process - Axios Pro
data.description:
Trimble Inc. (TRMB) is considering breaking up its transportation and logistics portfolio as it works with Goldman to sell the business, according to an  Axios Pro report on Friday

The update comes after Axios Pro reported in July that Trimble  (TRMB) was looking to sell its transportation and logistics arm.

Trimble CEO Robert Painter said on the company's Q2 earnings call last month that the company received "credible" inbound interest in its logistics and transportation business from  “multiple parties” and started a strategic review to evaluate third-party interest.
